title: The omnibus F-test and post-hoc comparisons

cues.en: Instructor: Let's continue our discussion of the ANOVA.
cues.zh: 講師：繼續討論 ANOVA。

cues.en: And here I'm going to define this thing called an Omnibus F-test.
cues.zh: 這裡要定義一個稱為整體 F 檢定的概念。

cues.en: In fact, you already know what that is.
cues.zh: 其實你已經知道它是什麼。

cues.en: You just have to learn to attach this label to it.
cues.zh: 只需要學會把這個名稱與它連結。

cues.en: And I'm also gonna talk about post-hoc comparisons and why we need to do post-hoc comparisons and when it is valid
cues.zh: 也會討論事後比較、為什麼需要事後比較，以及何時對 ANOVA 結果

cues.en: to perform post-hoc comparisons on the ANOVA results.
cues.zh: 進行事後比較才有效。

cues.en: Okay, so here we see an ANOVA table, just like the ANOVA table you saw in the previous video, although the coloring is a little bit nicer here, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡是一張 ANOVA 表，與上一支影片的一樣，只是這裡配色比較漂亮。

cues.en: And this is just a reminder of the correct interpretation of a significant P-value over here.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這裡顯著 P 值的正確解讀。

cues.en: So this P-value, if it's significant, it tells us that at least one group or level, possibly more, is statistically significantly different from the mean
cues.zh: P 值如果顯著，表示至少一個群組或水準，也可能更多，其平均值與至少另一個群組或水準的

cues.en: of at least one other group or level.
cues.zh: 平均值之差，達到統計顯著。

cues.en: There could be many differences or there could be just one difference.
cues.zh: 可能有很多差異，也可能只有一個差異。

cues.en: And this P-value doesn't tell us that.
cues.zh: P 值不會告訴我們。

cues.en: So this is, you know, like the problem with the ANOVA F-test.
cues.zh: 這就像 ANOVA F 檢定的問題。

cues.en: It's not really a problem per se, it's a feature of the ANOVA, but it's an important thing to know about.
cues.zh: 其實不算問題，而是一項特性，但很重要，必須知道。

cues.en: So this P-value doesn't tell us which things, which levels are different from which other levels.
cues.zh: P 值不會告訴我們，哪些項目、哪些水準，與哪些其他水準不同。

cues.en: It just tells us that something is different from something else.
cues.zh: 只會告訴我們，有某個東西與另一個不同。

cues.en: So to determine which groups actually differ from each other, we need a combination of data visualization and follow-up or post-hoc t-test.
cues.zh: 要判定哪些群組實際彼此不同，需要結合資料視覺化，以及後續、事後 t 檢定。

cues.en: Okay so, this is the F-test of the ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這就是 ANOVA 的 F 檢定。

cues.en: Now in this particular table, there's only one F value and that's because we only have one factor.
cues.zh: 這張表只有一個 F 值，因為只有一個因子。

cues.en: You will see in the next video that we can have multiple F-tests in an ANOVA when there are more than one factor.
cues.zh: 下一支影片會看到，超過一個因子時，ANOVA 可以有多個 F 檢定。

cues.en: And then we have the interaction terms and so on.
cues.zh: 還會有交互作用項等等。

cues.en: Okay, so here we have an ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 這裡是一張 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: These are from made-up data.
cues.zh: 來自編造的資料。

cues.en: So I made up the data that went into this table, but these are the real values from the numbers that I set up.
cues.zh: 我編出輸入表格的資料，但表中數值確實是從那些數字計算而來。

cues.en: Okay now, before going on, I would like you to pause the video and determine the total number of subjects in the dataset or the total number of data points
cues.zh: 繼續之前，希望你暫停影片，判定資料集的受試者總數，也就是資料點總數，

cues.en: that we have in this dataset, and the total number of levels within our factor, the total number of groups we have.
cues.zh: 以及因子中的水準總數，也就是群組總數。

cues.en: Okay, have you figured it out yet?
cues.zh: 想出來了嗎？

cues.en: So the answer is that, well, it's a one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 答案是，這是單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: There are 4 levels and 19 total data points.
cues.zh: 有 4 個水準，總共 19 個資料點。

cues.en: Now, how do I get these numbers?
cues.zh: 這些數字怎麼來？

cues.en: Well, we read them right from the degrees of freedom column.
cues.zh: 直接讀自由度那一欄。

cues.en: So the degrees of freedom for the total variability, the total sum squares is 18.
cues.zh: 總變異，也就是總平方和的自由度，是 18。

cues.en: And we know that that's N minus one.
cues.zh: 我們知道，那是 N 減 1。

cues.en: That means there's 19 data points in total.
cues.zh: 所以總共有 19 個資料點。

cues.en: And then we see that the between groups, sums of squared term has three associated degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 組間平方和這一項，對應的自由度是 3。

cues.en: And we also know that this is K minus one, or K is the total number of levels or the total number of groups within this factor.
cues.zh: 也知道這是 K 減 1，K 是這個因子的水準總數，或群組總數。

cues.en: So that's how we can infer, or I should say, determine that we have ANOVA with 4 levels and 19 data points.
cues.zh: 因此可以推得，或者說確定，ANOVA 有 4 個水準、19 個資料點。

cues.en: That's one of the useful features of printing the degrees of freedom right into the table here.
cues.zh: 這是在表格中直接列出自由度的一個好處。

cues.en: Okay and so we get a significant P-value.
cues.zh: 這裡得到顯著的 P 值。

cues.en: This is much less than 0.05.
So, and now with four levels, the only thing that this P-value tells us is that at least one of these four groups is different from at least one of the other four groups.
cues.zh: 有四個水準時，P 值唯一能告訴我們的是，這四組中至少一組與至少另一組不同。

cues.en: So now this F value over here, this is called the omnibus F-test.
cues.zh: 這裡的 F 值，稱為整體 F 檢定。

cues.en: And the omnibus F-test is like the general overarching test of significance.
cues.zh: 整體 F 檢定，是一般性的總體顯著性檢定。

cues.en: This is just telling us that something is different, but it doesn't tell us what it is.
cues.zh: 只告訴我們某處不同，不告訴我們是哪裡。

cues.en: So if you ever come across this term omnibus F-test that's referring to a test of a factor in an ANOVA and it basically just says that you know something is going on,
cues.zh: 所以看到 omnibus F-test 這個術語，指的是 ANOVA 中對某個因子的檢定，基本上只是說確實有某種效果，

cues.en: there isn't nothing in here, we are somehow able to reject the null hypothesis.
cues.zh: 這裡並非什麼都沒有，我們得以拒絕虛無假設。

cues.en: Okay so, what do you do when you're running ANOVA and you see a significant, well, the first thing that you do is visualize the data.
cues.zh: 進行 ANOVA 發現顯著之後，該怎麼做？首先把資料視覺化。

cues.en: So we might see a data visualization like this.
cues.zh: 可能看到這樣的資料圖。

cues.en: We have four levels, so a bar plot seems pretty appropriate here.
cues.zh: 有四個水準，所以長條圖相當適合。

cues.en: So here we have our four levels, our four groups within this one factor.
cues.zh: 這裡是單一因子的四個水準、四個群組。

cues.en: This is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 這是依變數。

cues.en: I apologize for not coming up with a sort of weird story about some crazy experiment that I ran with my imagination.
cues.zh: 抱歉，沒有想出某個我在想像中進行的古怪實驗故事。

cues.en: But anyway, I'll leave that up to you.
cues.zh: 就留給你自己想吧。

cues.en: So it looks like these two groups are the same and these two groups are the same.
cues.zh: 看起來這兩組相同，這兩組也相同。

cues.en: And these two groups collectively differ from these two groups.
cues.zh: 而這兩組整體，與另外兩組不同。

cues.en: I'm just making that, I'm just guessing purely based on visual inspection.
cues.zh: 我只是純粹根據目視檢查猜測。

cues.en: We don't actually know for sure.
cues.zh: 其實還不確定。

cues.en: It could be that this is different from this, but this group is not different from this group.
cues.zh: 可能這一組與這一組不同，但這組與這組卻沒有不同。

cues.en: So, that's sort of our problem.
cues.zh: 這就是問題。

cues.en: When we visualize the data, that's where to start.
cues.zh: 資料視覺化是起點。

cues.en: But it doesn't tell us which conditions are significantly different from which other conditions.
cues.zh: 但不能告訴我們，哪些條件與哪些其他條件的差異達到顯著。

cues.en: So you might think of going back to the t-test idea and computing all of the pairwise t-test.
cues.zh: 因此，你可能想到回到 t 檢定，計算所有成對 t 檢定。

cues.en: Well, there's two problems with this.
cues.zh: 這有兩個問題。

cues.en: One is that all possible comparisons testing each at 0.05 actually leads us to a family-wise error rate of 0.3, right?
cues.zh: 第一，所有可能的比較，都以 0.05 檢定，實際上會讓家族型錯誤率變成 0.3。

cues.en: So because there's six total comparisons, we have this one against this, this against this, this against this.
cues.zh: 因為總共有六個比較：這個對這個、這個對這個、這個對這個。

cues.en: And then we have this against this and this against this.
cues.zh: 接著這個對這個，以及這個對這個。

cues.en: And finally this one against this one.
cues.zh: 最後是這個對這個。

cues.en: So total of six comparisons that we can make here with these four levels.
cues.zh: 這四個水準，總共可以進行六個比較。

cues.en: So when we test each of these at 0.05, a significance level of 0.05, then the total error rate is actually 0.3, which is unacceptably high for a type one error rate.
cues.zh: 每個比較都以 0.05 的顯著水準檢定時，總錯誤率其實是 0.3，作為第一類錯誤率，高得無法接受。

cues.en: And there's another problem with just comparing individual t-test like this, and that is that these, all of these groups are not independent from each other.
cues.zh: 另外，這樣單獨比較 t 檢定還有個問題，就是這些群組彼此並不獨立。

cues.en: They're all embedded in the same experiment.
cues.zh: 它們都包含在同一個實驗中。

cues.en: We designed the experiment to have these four conditions, okay?
cues.zh: 實驗設計本來就有這四個條件。

cues.en: So it turns out in the context of the ANOVA, a good way to correct for multiple comparisons and do post-hoc t-test, post-hoc comparisons is
cues.zh: 在 ANOVA 脈絡下，一種適合校正多重比較，並進行事後 t 檢定、事後比較的方法，

cues.en: through something called the Tukey test.
cues.zh: 稱為 Tukey 檢定。

cues.en: You have to be careful with the spelling here.
cues.zh: 拼字要小心。

cues.en: This is not the Turkey test, it is the Tukey test.
cues.zh: 不是 Turkey 火雞檢定，而是 Tukey 檢定。

cues.en: Tukey was a famous mathematician and statistician in the 20th century.
cues.zh: Tukey 是二十世紀著名的數學家與統計學家。

cues.en: He made a lot of contributions to statistics and he actually made a lot of really important contributions to digital signal processing as well.
cues.zh: 對統計有很多貢獻，也對數位訊號處理有許多重要貢獻。

cues.en: So if you're familiar with the Fourier transform, then you've probably also heard of the Fast Fourier Transform.
cues.zh: 如果熟悉傅立葉轉換，應該也聽過快速傅立葉轉換。

cues.en: And Tukey is one of the people who discovered the modern algorithm for the Fast Fourier Transform, which is arguably one of the most important operations
cues.zh: Tukey 是發現現代快速傅立葉轉換演算法的人之一，它可說是整個現代資訊通訊技術中，

cues.en: in all of modern information communications technology.
cues.zh: 最重要的運算之一。

cues.en: It's so important.
cues.zh: 非常重要。

cues.en: I even have an entire course just on the Fourier Transform and Tukey was pretty instrumental to basically how, you know, cell phones communicate, how images get compressed, all this kind
cues.zh: 我甚至有整門專門談傅立葉轉換的課，而 Tukey 對手機如何通訊、影像如何壓縮，以及各種

cues.en: of really neat digital signal processing and digital image processing stuff.
cues.zh: 有趣的數位訊號處理與數位影像處理，都有重大影響。

cues.en: Anyway, that is neither here nor there.
cues.zh: 不過，這是題外話。

cues.en: So the Tukey test allows for post-hoc comparisons while controlling for the family-wise error rate.
cues.zh: Tukey 檢定可以在控制家族型錯誤率的同時，進行事後比較。

cues.en: So post-hoc comparisons here, it means that we are testing individual conditions after we have already tested that the ANOVA is significant.
cues.zh: 這裡的事後比較，是指已經檢驗 ANOVA 顯著之後，再檢驗個別條件。

cues.en: So how does the Tukey test work?
cues.zh: Tukey 檢定如何運作？

cues.en: Well, it's fairly straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: So we come up with a statistic value here, it's called Q, and this is the definition of Q.
cues.zh: 計算一個稱為 Q 的統計值，這裡是 Q 的定義。

cues.en: So we take in the numerator is the means of the two conditions.
cues.zh: 分子是兩個條件的平均值。

cues.en: So this would be condition B and condition S.
cues.zh: 這裡是條件 B 與條件 S。

cues.en: I don't remember why I labeled these things B and S, but this is just whichever two conditions you are comparing here.
cues.zh: 我不記得為什麼標成 B 與 S，它們只是你正在比較的兩個條件。

cues.en: So, that would be, you know, this mean versus this mean.
cues.zh: 例如這個平均值與這個平均值。

cues.en: This, we could call X-bar B.
cues.zh: 這個可以稱為 X 平均值下標 B。

cues.en: And this mean we could call X-bar S.
cues.zh: 這個平均值則稱為 X 平均值下標 S。

cues.en: And then we do, you know, when we test these ones, this would be B, and this would be S.
cues.zh: 測試另外這一對時，這個是 B，這個是 S。

cues.en: So just the two groups, the means of the two groups that you're comparing.
cues.zh: 就是正在比較的兩組平均值。

cues.en: And their difference goes in the numerator and the denominator is, well you know, it gets a little complicated, but it's essentially a variance term
cues.zh: 兩者之差放在分子；分母有點複雜，但基本上是一個變異數項，

cues.en: and it's multiplied by somehow a factor of N, which is the total number of subjects or the total number of data points.
cues.zh: 再以某種方式乘上 N 的因子，N 是受試者總數或資料點總數。

cues.en: Now when you look at this formula, what comes to mind?
cues.zh: 看這個公式，你想到什麼？

cues.en: What have we already discussed in this course that looks a little bit like this formula?
cues.zh: 本課程已經討論過的哪個東西，與它有點相似？

cues.en: I'm sure you are thinking of the T-test.
cues.zh: 相信你想到 t 檢定。

cues.en: This Q, this Tukey Q test is not a T-test, just to be clear, is not the same thing as a t-test.
cues.zh: 這個 Q、Tukey Q 檢定，並不是 t 檢定，說清楚，它與 t 檢定不相同。

cues.en: We don't evaluate it the same way as we evaluated t-test.
cues.zh: 評估方式也與 t 檢定不同。

cues.en: But I would like you to see that there is conceptual similarity to the t-test.
cues.zh: 但希望你看到，它在概念上與 t 檢定相似。

cues.en: And that is we are looking at a difference between the means and we are scaling that by some measure of variance and something about the total number of data points.
cues.zh: 我們看的是平均值差異，再用某種變異量，以及資料點總數相關的量來縮放。

cues.en: So this is the formula for the Tukey Q, so Q has its own distribution, actually it's evaluated, it's a Q distribution
cues.zh: 這是 Tukey Q 的公式。Q 有自己的分布，稱為 Q 分布，

cues.en: and it has j,n-j degrees of freedom, where J is the total number of comparisons, and N is the total number of data values.
cues.zh: 自由度是 J 與 N 減 J，J 是比較總數，N 是資料值總數。

cues.en: Now to be clear, J is not the total number of possible comparisons.
cues.zh: 說清楚，J 不是所有可能的比較總數。

cues.en: It's the total number of comparisons that you plan on doing.
cues.zh: 而是你計畫進行的比較總數。

cues.en: So for example, if you want to test every possible pair here, then J would be equal to six.
cues.zh: 例如，若想測試這裡每個可能配對，J 就等於 6。

cues.en: But let's say you only wanna test, you know, because of the theory you're working with or because of how you want to interpret the data.
cues.zh: 但如果基於理論，或你希望如何解讀資料，

cues.en: Maybe not all the conditions are relevant for each other.
cues.zh: 並非所有條件彼此都相關，

cues.en: Maybe you just wanna test this one against the other three and then this one against this one.
cues.zh: 可能只想把這個條件與另外三個相比，再把這個與這個相比。

cues.en: So now we have 1, 2, 3, 4 total comparisons.
cues.zh: 這樣總共有 1、2、3、4 個比較。

cues.en: So there's six possible ways to compare these four levels, but we are only interested in four.
cues.zh: 四個水準有六種可能比較，但我們只關心四種。

cues.en: So therefore, in this case, J would be equal to four.
cues.zh: 所以這裡 J 等於 4。

cues.en: Now, this is not a formula that I recommend memorizing, committing to memory.
cues.zh: 不建議背下這個公式。

cues.en: All of your statistics programs and packages are going to implement this formula for you.
cues.zh: 所有統計程式與套件，都會替你實作。

cues.en: What I would like you to remember is that the Tukey test for post-hoc comparisons is something that's conceptually similar to a t-test.
cues.zh: 希望你記住，事後比較的 Tukey 檢定，在概念上類似 t 檢定。

cues.en: And the way that we evaluate these significance depends on the number of comparisons that we are making.
cues.zh: 評估顯著性的方式，取決於進行多少個比較。

cues.en: Not the number of total comparisons, but the number of comparisons that are relevant for us that we want to make with these data.
cues.zh: 不是全部可能的比較數，而是對我們有意義、想對這份資料進行的比較數。

cues.en: Okay, there's one final thing that I would like to mention about post-hoc comparisons with an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 最後還想補充 ANOVA 事後比較的一點。

cues.en: And that is you're only allowed to compare the individual conditions when the omnibus F-test is significant.
cues.zh: 只有整體 F 檢定顯著時，才能比較個別條件。

cues.en: So if the F-test is not significant that the ANOVA is telling you that nothing is significantly different from anything else.
cues.zh: F 檢定不顯著，ANOVA 就是在告訴你，沒有任何項目與其他項目的差異達到顯著。

cues.en: So then you are not allowed to do a post-hoc comparison.
cues.zh: 因此不允許進行事後比較。

cues.en: So to make that clear, I'll go back to this bar.
cues.zh: 為了說清楚，回到這張長條圖。

cues.en: If the ANOVA from the table, here if this ANOVA term were not statistically significant, if this P-value were larger than 0.05,
cues.zh: 如果表格中的 ANOVA 項未達統計顯著，也就是 P 值大於 0.05，

cues.en: then we would just have to stop there.
cues.zh: 就必須停在這裡。

cues.en: And we say that there is no evidence of significant effect of the factor.
cues.zh: 說沒有證據顯示這個因子有顯著效果。

cues.en: There's no evidence that the different levels, the different groups are significantly different from each other and therefore we stop.
cues.zh: 沒有證據顯示不同水準、不同群組彼此有顯著差異，所以停止。

cues.en: We cannot do post-hoc t-test individual comparisons when the F statistic is not statistically significant.
cues.zh: F 統計量未達顯著時，不能進行個別的事後 t 檢定比較。

cues.en: So, that's the end of this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片到這裡。

cues.en: You learned about the term omnibus F-test and you learn the Tukey tests for post-hoc comparisons if the F-test in ANOVA is significant.
cues.zh: 你學到了整體 F 檢定這個術語，也學到 ANOVA 的 F 檢定顯著時，使用 Tukey 檢定進行事後比較。

cues.en: One final thing that I can mention is that there are in fact multiple post-hoc comparison methods.
cues.zh: 最後補充，事後比較其實有多種方法。

cues.en: The Tukey method is one of them.
cues.zh: Tukey 是其中一種。

cues.en: It's by far the most common one, so it's the one I'm teaching you about.
cues.zh: 它遠比其他方法常用，所以我教這個。

cues.en: But just so you're aware, there are other methods to control for multiple comparisons in post-doc comparisons in ANOVA.
cues.zh: 不過也讓你知道，ANOVA 的事後比較，還有其他控制多重比較的方法。
